dogecoin.text: Went on a golf trip this weekend. Homie was talking about how he was up 250k in $DOGE... There’s nothing I could have said that would have made him sell. He’s probably still holding. #Crypto lessons have to be learned the hard way.

Tik Tok kids making coins like #CumRocket, and $ASS... Brady and a bunch of celebrities putting laser eyes, f*cking Elon, Doge coin at 70 cents. This sh*t HAD to get wrecked. The market always punishes this behavior. Once enough people are sacrificed only then can we continue.
My friend's boomer dad texted him and asked about @coinbase and $doge.... You can feel the tidal wave coming. All of #crypto is about to pop the fuk OFF.
